accountEmail.title: Account Email
accountEmail.description: The email address of the company. This is optional

accountName.title: Account Name
accountName.description: The company name for this opportunity. A new account will be automatically created

accountPhone.title: Account Phone
accountPhone.description: The phone number of the company. Numbers only, no spaces or dashes

closeDate.title: Close Date
closeDate.description: The expected close date of the opportunity in YYYY-MM-DD format

opportunityName.title: Opportunity Name
opportunityName.description: The name of the opportunity deal

ownerId.title: Owner Id
ownerId.description: The Salesforce User Id of the user creating the opportunity. This is automatically set by the system

stageName.title: Stage Name
stageName.description: The current sales stage of the opportunity such as Prospecting, Qualification, Proposal, Negotiation, Closed Won or Closed Lost
